headline: Up to $10,000 for a neighbourhood project. Applications close Nov. 8
dek: The city's Neighbourhood Placemaking program funds things like benches, plant libraries and street painting.
body: Neighbourhood Placemaking is an annual municipal program that helps neighbours connect through a shared project. The city's examples include seed and plant libraries, neighbourhood benches, upcycled art installations and street painting.

Successful applicants get training, guidance and funding. There are three streams: Placemaking Create for neighbour-led projects on any theme, Placemaking Art for projects that hire an artist, and Environmental Placemaking for projects that add to climate resilience and sustainability.
The virtual information session was held Oct. 20. If you missed it, the city says you can talk through your idea with the Community Developer for your area before the deadline.
means: Projects that hire an artist or help with climate resilience qualify for the larger amounts.
